m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>This ground nest looks recently abandoned, and there are signs of a struggle. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You find some feathers and a few sparkling rings. Could be evidence of the princess. A trail leads off into a nearby clearing. </ITALICS>
How could you have lost that songbird, Lady Zenzen!?
It wasn't me that first found her. It was you!
I knocked her out of the sky!
You barely scratched her! So she got away from me!
Never mind. We have her scepter and cloak and a handful of feathers. We can use that to convince King Neza she is our prisoner.
He will have no choice but to believe us. Wait, what was that noise?
The Shadow Queen will not like this one bit!
<ITALICS>You collect all of the Lady Zenzen's trappings that the bad guys were holding. No other sign of the princess, though. </ITALICS>
It's good that you heard and foiled their plot. Lady Zenzen must still be safe, in hiding.
Lady Zenzen must be hiding down here to keep out of the Shadow Queen's clutches. If they caught her, King Neza would break!
We must find Lady Zenzen before the Shadow servants can. Search for any evidence of Lady Zenzen's trail you can find!
Search for any clues that might let us find Lady Zenzen's trail before the Splinter Wings!
